_about: Crux Tập 1 · C4 animatic / C5 final picture: the signed C3 final token set with every type size cut ~20% (owner, C3 contract signature 29/09/2026) and a floor of 40 px at 1080p. Colours, materials, motion grammar unchanged. Scenes are laid out in 1920x1080 logical px; C4 rendered them at 1280x720, C5 renders the final picture at 1920x1080 (canvas.out).

roles.window: accent at 18% fill, only over weeks whose rate is at least 1 point below Nora's
roles.bill: paper ream (H1) / ink-muted outline block (H3); never a character colour
roles.saved: cash bundles (H1 material 'cash') / green slices with a dark seam per month (H3)
roles.owed: hatched slab: diagonal stripes negative on paper (H1) or negative hatch (H3) = still owed on the new loan vs the old one; the hatch is what separates it from Anjali's solid square
roles.missed: ink-muted hatch = an amount that was possible and is gone

hero.use: the one number of the beat

note.use: smallest allowed: source line, units, footnotes (cap 35 px)

type.rule: px = max(40, round(0.8 x C3 px)); smallest 40 px at 1080p = cap 29.1 px (7.3 px at 25%)

motion.draw: a line extends left to right = time passes
motion.stack: one unit lands per month (H1 cash bundle, H3 slice) = money accumulates; one unit = one month
motion.grow: a block grows or appears on top of another = an amount appears (what is still owed)
motion.lift: an object rises out of a pile and hangs, glowing = an amount that was on offer
motion.drop: it greys and falls back into the pile = the offer was not taken / it is gone
motion.slide: a marker slides along a ruler and stops = reading a value on a scale
motion.strike: a red line through a statement = that answer is wrong
motion.outline: a wire-outline object with no number = the viewer's own case, unknown to us
motion.cut: hard cut between an H3 chart and an H1 room = change of scale (the market <-> one household)
motion.camera: slow push-in only (<= 20 px/s drift); no shake, no orbit, no particles
